subject: general
question: Famous singer Teejan Bai is related to which of the following folk musics?
solution:
The correct answer is** __Pandvani__**.

** [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] __Key Points__**

 
• Teejan Bai is an exponent of Pandavani, a traditional performing art form, from **Chhattisgarh**, in which she enacts tales from the Mahabharata with musical accompaniments.
